## What this changes

One paragraph. Link the issue if there is one: Fixes #

## Checklist

- [ ] `make verify` passes (check, typecheck, test)
- [ ] User-visible change has a tutorial step with an Expected block, or a how-to or reference update; `make docs-gen` was run if CLI or schema text changed
- [ ] Generated artefacts regenerated (`make gen`) if tool specs or client adapters changed
- [ ] A changed design decision has a new ADR under `docs/adr`; accepted ADRs are not edited
- [ ] No milestone ids in code, tests or docs content
- [ ] No secrets, keys or `.env` content anywhere in the diff
